about: Shared gate vectors. One file drives every port of the gate (Python lang runtime, Agent Ultra's Kotlin gate). A port that disagrees with a vector is wrong or the vector is; either way it is visible. Add a vector with every fix. A vector may carry 'needs': a port that lacks that feature skips it and says so. Fake secrets are 16 characters after the prefix: the gate detects them; key scanners (20+) do not flag them.
